title: Human Grade
description: Optional grade.json: verbatim post-scrub copy of the producer's canonical human grade (the loop's verdict signal). additionalProperties are tolerated for forward-compat - the file is copied, not authored, by the package assembler.

recipe_semantic.description: The human verdict on the run's recipe/approach.

reasoning.description: Why the grade was given. Subject to the scrub gate like any package text.

graded_by.description: Grader identifier (a pseudonymous key is fine).
